note: Topps NSCC wrapper-redemption Bowman Chrome, 50-card base set, BNR- prefix (BCP checklist transcribed verbatim). THE LADDER IS THE POINT: the catalog already held this set from baseballcardpedia + tcdb, but every ungraded row carried parallel 'Base' and NOT ONE ladder row existed, so the numbered rungs had no address and their sales keyed onto whatever slug was nearest. The unnumbered base card IS ITSELF a Prism Refractor -- that is this product's finish, confirmed by market titles (#BNR-TM 'PRISM REFRACTOR', #BNRNS 'Prism Refractors') -- so the unnumbered rung is 'Prism Refractor' with a BLANK printRun (not serial-numbered), and the colours are Gold/Orange/Red/Black PRISM REFRACTOR at /50, /25, /5 and 1/1. BLACK IS THE 1/1, plain Prism is the unnumbered base: the reverse of what the pool assumed. Autographs (34 subjects, same BNR- prefix, Red /5 + Black 1/1) are NOT emitted here -- per-player auto print runs vary and BCP does not state them all; blank means unknown, so the auto set is left for its own sourced pass rather than guessed.
